// diagnostic

L0520

`{type}` has no `Display` impl; use the explicit debug selector for this interpolation.

What

`{type}` has no `Display` impl; use the explicit debug selector for this interpolation.

Why

Bare interpolation is moving to the explicit `Display` hook; the canonical migration edit keeps the value user-owned.

Fix

Replace `{value}` with `{{{value}:Debug}}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0520: tests/ui_lint/build_entry_liveness.warn.

Warning [jet.RedundantFinalReturn]: An explicit `return` is used on the final value line
  --> build_entry_liveness.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     return b.plan()
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: An unadorned expression on the final value line is Jet's implicit return; `return` is for early exits
 Fix: Remove the final `return` and leave the expression as the block tail
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0530

Warning [jet.DisplayMigration]: `MissingDisplay` has no `Display` impl; use the explicit debug selector for this interpolation.
  --> build_entry_liveness.jet:13:13
    |
 13 |     print("{value}")
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: Bare interpolation is moving to the explicit `Display` hook (D-DISPLAY-SHAPE); the canonical migration edit keeps the value user-owned.
 Fix: Replace `value` with `{value:Debug}`.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0520

Warning [jet.UnusedPrivateFn]: Private function `unused_private` is never called or used as a value.
  --> build_entry_liveness.jet:9:4
    |
  9 | fn unused_private() {}
    |    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A private function with no reachable reference is dead code; public functions stay exempt because other modules may use them.
 Fix: Remove the function, or rename `unused_private` to `_unused_private` when it is intentional.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0104
